description: Unit test class for the AcknowledgementsJsonParser, verifying parsing and validation of acknowledgment JSON representations in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.acks.base package.

classes.name: AcknowledgementsJsonParserTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for AcknowledgementsJsonParser, testing parsing of acknowledgment JSON data.

classes.name: ThingIdAcknowledgementJsonParser
classes.description: Inner class extending AcknowledgementJsonParser for creating entity IDs of type ThingId.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test case.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the parser class is immutable.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullAcknowledgementJsonParser
methods.description: Tests that passing null as parser returns NullPointerException.

methods.name: parseNullJsonObject
methods.description: Tests that parsing a null JSON object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: parseJsonWithSeveralAcksOfSameLabel
methods.description: Checks parsing acknowledgment JSON with multiple acknowledgments of the same label.

methods.name: parseValidJsonRepresentationOfNonEmptyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies parsing a valid JSON of non-empty acknowledgments.

methods.name: parseValidJsonRepresentationOfEmptyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies parsing a valid JSON of empty acknowledgments.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutEntityId
methods.description: Checks error handling when entity ID is missing in JSON.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutEntityType
methods.description: Checks error handling when entity type is missing.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidEntityType
methods.description: Checks error when entity type in JSON is invalid.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithUnexpectedEntityType
methods.description: Checks error when entity type does not match expected.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks error when ditto headers are missing.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks error when ditto headers are invalid.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks error when acknowledgements array is missing.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks error when acknowledgements array is invalid.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidAcknowledgementJsonRepresentation
methods.description: Checks error when individual acknowledgement JSON is invalid.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithDifferentAcknowledgementEntityId
methods.description: Checks error when acknowledgement entity ID differs from expected.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutStatusCode
methods.description: Checks error when status code is missing.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithUnknownStatusCode
methods.description: Checks error for unsupported status code.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithUnexpectedStatusCode
methods.description: Checks error when read status code differs from expected.
